name: cyberfarm.guide.handbook
landing_text: Welcome, engineer! $(l)CyberFarm$() lets you build modular drones that run your farms for you. You assemble a drone from a $(l)frame$(), one or more $(l)function modules$() and optional $(l)addons$(), give it a $(l)Drone Dock$() to live on, and it does the work while you do something more fun.
subtitle: Everything about drones, power and machines
